message: `trait` is no longer part of Axiom
label: `trait` was removed: an interface is a CAPABILITY RECORD now - a parameterised struct holding the functions, passed as a value. `(struct ShowOf (a) (render : (-> a String)))`, and `(ShowOf fmtInt)` is the instance
help: declare a capability record instead: `(struct ShowOf (a) (render : (-> a String)))`, and bind an instance with `fn` - `(fn (showInt) (ShowOf fmtInt))`. Call through the field: `((c.render) x)`
